title: debiaSAE: Benchmarking and Mitigating Vision-Language Model Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using pronoun resolution accuracy across different occupations (VisoGender) measured via Resolution Bias (RB), measuring Demographic Parity Ratio (DPR) for facial attribute classification tasks across genders (UTKFace, PATA, CelebA), and calculating the selection rate of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical captions (VLStereoSet).

Measured by calculating the Demographic Parity Ratio (DPR) for visual classification tasks across different racial groups (UTKFace, PATA) and tracking the selection frequency of racially stereotypical captions over anti-stereotypical ones in multiple-choice scenarios (VLStereoSet).

Assessed by computing the Demographic Parity Ratio (DPR) to evaluate performance and fairness discrepancies across different age groups during facial attribute prediction and caption selection tasks (UTKFace, PATA).

Evaluated by measuring the Vision-Language Bias Score (VLBS), which calculates the percentage of instances where models select religiously stereotypical captions over anti-stereotypical ones (VLStereoSet).

Measured by testing how strongly models associate specific genders with certain professional roles via pronoun resolution tasks (VisoGender) and computing the preference for stereotypical professional captions (VLStereoSet).
